rule: Unnormalized latent state <- momentum*previous + (1-momentum)*complete latest-group Raw mean; initialize from first actual mean. history: All old Raw commits/moves/parents/versions/empty tombstones retained. Empty token unavailable despite old latent state; revival retains latent/history, never clean reset.
